page.notes: No marginal notes, catchword or signature are printed on this page. The small mark at the left edge (around mid-page) and the faint digitiser text at the bottom right were left out. The reading "antistitelque" (line 9) is uncertain and may be "antistitesque"; the scan is hard to read there. The long s has been written as plain s throughout, and "Conftat", "conftituunt" and similar forms were normalised to "Constat" and "constituunt" in the transcription only where the printed ligature was clear. Printed hyphens at line ends (pe-, coenobio-, agri-, di-, provin-) are kept.
